title: Common themes
content: Wanted to just list the themes of my dream experiences: Hills, mountains, construction of a new mansion, houses on the water with decks, floating docks, neighborhood far away—long windy road. Mall world—movie theatre, water parks, races, shops, school hallways, open house like environment, a dorm/college campus, airport/escalators with a macys like feel, old friends here and there, the feeling that we are “waiting” for something together and killing time.
